Fishing Manual:
A fishing dock can be wherever there is a large enough concentration of fish to make it worthwhile for people to go fishing.
The places that are good for fishing are the following: Iris Lake, Narsell Lake where the Coliseum is, Giran Harbor, around the Plains of the Lizardmen, waterside in the Town of Gludio, the Neutral Zone, Heine, Fellmere Lake, the bridges in the Town of Giran, and inside Aden.
